name: vmodal-lookbook
description: Build a capsule wardrobe and outfit lookbook from a style brief (city, month, temperature, occasion, style), grounded in real street-style footage in VModal: discover what people actually wear in that season, plan 8–12 pieces and 5–7 outfit formulas, then prove each outfit with verified real frames. Use when the user asks to "dress me for", "what to wear in Milan in November", "capsule wardrobe", "lookbook", "packing list" or "outfits for a trip", e.g. "Capsule for Milan in November, 8°C, aperitivo in Brera. Collection: fashion_milan". Requires the vmodal MCP and the vmodal-find skill.
